result.summary: Found a misspelled search placeholder and minor visual inconsistencies with favorite icon styling and carousel clipping.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card lacks the dark circular background/scrim seen on the card below, leaving white outline directly on image with low contrast.
